name: How it works, ticket stubs
description: Each step is a torn ticket stub with a perforated edge and a big number, set in a row and tilted alternately.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Hire the Rex for a night of your own

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Birthdays, film clubs and works nights out, on a screen with nobody else in it. Four stubs between you and the opening titles.

default.label: 6 weeks out
default.title: Pick your evening
default.text: Tell us the date and the size of your party. Screen Two seats 38, the main house 140.

default.label: 4 weeks out
default.title: Choose the film
default.text: A 1950s musical or last month's release: if it can be licensed, we clear the rights for you.

default.label: 1 week out
default.title: Plan the interval
default.text: Popcorn tubs, a cheese board or an open bar in the foyer. Send final numbers by Monday.

default.label: On the night
default.title: Lights down
default.text: Doors open half an hour early for your guests, and your name goes up on the marquee.
